name: Bring Back a Bang

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the destructive power of mining explosives, especially when they fall into the hands of your bitter Dark Iron kin.
As an engineer, you know blasting powder and volatile compounds need careful handling and containment. Unsecured stores can bring disaster.

faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves raided a nearby construction site and carried barrels of blasting powder to their tents east on Direforge Hill.
The Dark Iron dwarves hauled the stolen barrels east to their camps on Direforge Hill.
faq.q: Where did the Dark Irons take the barrels?

faq.answer: Red markings distinguish the stolen construction barrels from ordinary supplies.
faq.q: How can you identify the stolen explosives?

faq.answer: The construction workers cannot spare the materials, and blasting powder in malicious Dark Iron hands threatens everyone nearby.
faq.q: Why do the explosives need to be recovered?

faq.answer: Direforge Hill lies east of the local worksite, where hostile Dark Iron dwarf camps have taken hold.
Dark Iron dwarves are a treacherous faction, known for malice, dark sorcery, and lasting hostility toward their kin and neighbors.
faq.q: Who are the Dark Iron dwarves?

sections.body: Dark Iron dwarves camp east on Direforge Hill. They raided a nearby construction site and carried its vital blasting powder back to their tents.
sections.title: Theft at the Construction Site

sections.body: Blasting powder in malicious Dark Iron hands threatens the surrounding lands. The stolen barrels bear red markings that set them apart from common supplies. Recover them before the dwarves put the powder to destructive use.
sections.title: Volatile Hands

summary: A construction site has lost blasting powder to Dark Iron dwarves camped east on Direforge Hill. Their marked barrels could bring danger to the surrounding lands.
attribution: In-game quest text: Bring Back a Bang
